review.note: Proclamation of Feb. 22, 1897 (No. 30), 29 Stat. 909, Grover Cleveland; reserve in the Big Horn Mountains of Wyoming, later known as the Big Horn Forest Reserve. Suspended by the act of June 4, 1897 until March 1, 1898. The 1897 proclamations do not print a reserve name; the name comes from later records.
